urls.rationale: Title 3 - Legislative Branch contains Subtitle A Chapter 305 (Registration of Lobbyists), the lobbying-disclosure statute body.

notes: Government Code title page exposes title-level links only (Texas tree is 5-deep: state -> code -> title -> subtitle -> chapter). Pass-2 chosen URL is Title 3; an intermediate descent through subtitle-a is required before reaching the chapter-305 leaf. Other titles (Title 5 Open Government; Ethics, Title 6 Public Officers and Employees) reviewed but excluded: they cover ethics/officer rules generally, not the lobbying-registration regime which is specifically codified in Title 3 Subtitle A Ch. 305.
